content: Customer Diya Menon called insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh regarding a policy cancellation notice. The customer was confused about her payment status, but the agent clarified there was a missed $150 premium for last month and a missing signed rider form. Diya paid the $150 premium over the phone to reinstate the policy and agreed to sign and return the PDF copy of the rider form emailed by the agent.

action_items: Agent to email PDF copy of the rider form to the customer
Customer to sign and email back the rider form today
